For your information, found by basalt on 2026-10-04 10:15 UTC

  worker.service ran out of memory and was stopped by the kernel. It reached
  its memory limit (MemoryMax=256.0 MiB).

Nothing will be changed: this is a report for you to read.

Next step

  low, otherwise find out why it needs so much.
  Commands you may run yourself:
